blocks.text:
Flight from São Paulo to Rio; on arrival, transfer to your hotel. Take the rest of your first day to discover the city at a relaxed pace.

Rio is surrounded by green hills, bays, islands and the ocean. Brazil’s second-largest city is one of those great metropolises where nature is always in view. Copacabana, Ipanema and Leblon stretch along the coast, and their black-and-white mosaic promenades are instantly recognisable. From early morning until late at night, people play football and volleyball on the golden sand, stroll or jog along the waterfront, and meet friends. Beach cafés serve cold coconut water, fresh juices and other drinks to the sound of local musicians. Those looking for an active holiday can try surfing, diving, rafting, tennis, golf, hang-gliding and other sports in Rio; local musicians frequently perform on the beaches, so the city begins to make an impression long before the first excursion.
